mo_ta_cong_viec:
Founded in 2016, Katalon is the category leader in AI-augmented software testing, empowering hybrid testers—those blending manual, automation, and AI skills—to deliver exceptional digital experiences. Katalon enables software teams of any size to deliver world-class customer experiences faster, easier, and more efficiently.
Since its first launch, Katalon has experienced tremendous growth, serving more than 30,000 teams across 80+ countries, many of which are in the Fortune Global 500. Katalon has been named a G2 Leader in software testing for 11 consecutive quarters and a Great Place to Work for three consecutive years.About the role
We are looking for a Senior Database Engineer / DBA to own Katalon’s production database environment, with a primary focus on PostgreSQL / AWS Aurora.
You will manage approximately 10 production database clusters hosting customer data on AWS, working closely with our Engineering team in Vietnam on database performance, reliability, architecture, security, and future upgrades.
We are open to strong Oracle DBA profiles with solid cross-database fundamentals and the ability to work with PostgreSQL/Aurora.Key Responsibilities
Manage and maintain production PostgreSQL / AWS Aurora databases.
Troubleshoot and resolve performance, availability, locking, concurrency, and query issues.
Perform query tuning, indexing, and database performance optimization.
Design databases and schemas for new customer workloads.
Manage high availability, replication, backup/recovery, and failover.
Monitor database health, capacity, and performance using CloudWatch, Performance Insights, and Enhanced Monitoring.
Manage database users, roles, permissions, and security controls.
Plan and execute database upgrades, migrations, and maintenance.
Partner closely with Engineering teams on database-related requirements and production incidents.
yeu_cau:
Job Requirements
5+ years of experience in DBA / Database Engineering.
Strong experience with production database administration and troubleshooting.
Strong knowledge of performance tuning, SQL, indexing, HA/replication, backup & recovery, and database security.
Experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora OR Oracle.
Strong understanding of database architecture and operational best practices.
Good communication and collaboration skills.Technology
Primary: PostgreSQL, AWS Aurora, AWS RDS, CloudWatch
Oracle profiles are welcome: Candidates with strong Oracle DBA experience and transferable database fundamentals are encouraged to apply. Experience with PostgreSQL/Aurora or Oracle-to-PostgreSQL migration is a plus.Nice to Have
Experience with both Oracle and PostgreSQL.
AWS database experience.
Experience supporting customer-facing SaaS production environments.
Experience in a lean, high-ownership DBA environment.
